scope: Mac single-CPU Bionic/ART cache settings comparison; desktop performance and iPhone for these settings remain unverified.

matrix.scope: Same guest/kernel inputs; separate host executables for execution comparison; balanced configuration order

independent.scope: Independent runtime ARM64 blocks; no Linux/Android/iPhone integration
independent.measurement: Three warm rounds per engine in separate processes, reversed process order for GCD. Same ARM64 bytes and checked results. Direct includes one-million-instruction slice entries; Unicorn includes register exchange. Memory phases include initialization and result verification, with arithmetic sample mean, sampled peak and latest; lifetime RSS peak is separate.

linux_core.scope: Native single-CPU LKL with translated ARM64 userspace; selected workload only; iPhone unverified
linux_core.measurement: Guest clock times 128 pipe round trips per memory case; excludes initial COW materialization. Selected preemption, translation and selected Linux mapping implementation included. Memory means are arithmetic sample means, including phase boundaries; sampled peaks can miss short peaks. Resident lifetime peak is separate.

baseline_profile.profiling: Three two-second stack samples at 5 ms; diagnostic only
